import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/test_1.csv"
target_output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/target_multisource_cot.csv"

# Load Source 0
# Note: index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column as per Hint 24
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Rename Source 0 columns to match the target schema suffix "_15"
# Source 0 columns:
# ['Country', 'Region', 'Happiness Rank', 'Happiness Score', 'Standard Error',
#  'Economy (GDP per Capita)', 'Family', 'Health (Life Expectancy)', 'Freedom',
#  'Trust (Government Corruption)', 'Generosity', 'Dystopia Residual']

df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
    'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
    'Family': 'Family_15',
    'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom': 'Freedom_15',
    'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
    'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
})

# Select only the columns needed for the target from source 0
df0_selected = df0_renamed[[
    'Country', 'Region', 'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15'
]]

# Load Source 1
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Source 1 columns already mostly match target suffix "_17":
# ['Country', 'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
#  'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17',
#  'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17']

# Select only the columns needed for the target from source 1
df1_selected = df1[[
    'Country', 'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17',
    'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]]

# Join Source 0 and Source 1 on 'Country'
# Since Source 0 has 'Region' and Source 1 does not, keep 'Region' from Source 0
# Use inner join to keep only countries present in both sources (target examples have 75 rows, source0 has 79, source1 has 155)
df_merged = pd.merge(df0_selected, df1_selected, on='Country', how='inner')

# After merge, 'Region' is from df0_selected, so it is present

# Reorder columns to match the target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Country', 'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15',
    'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17',
    'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]

df_final = df_merged[target_columns]

# Ensure data types match target schema:
# According to target schema:
# 'Country': string
# 'Region': string
# 'Happiness_Rank_15': integer
# 'Happiness_Score_15': float
# 'Standard_Error_15': float
# 'Economy_15': float
# 'Family_15': float
# 'Life_Expectancy_15': float
# 'Freedom_15': float
# 'Trust_15': float
# 'Generosity_15': float
# 'Dystopia_15': float
# 'Happiness_Rank_17': integer
# 'Happiness_Score_17': float
# 'Whisker_High_17': float
# 'Whisker_Low_17': float
# 'Economy_17': float
# 'Family_17': float
# 'Life_Expectancy_17': float
# 'Freedom_17': float
# 'Generosity_17': float
# 'Trust_17': float
# 'Dystopia_17': float

# Convert types explicitly
df_final['Country'] = df_final['Country'].astype(str)
df_final['Region'] = df_final['Region'].astype(str)

int_columns = ['Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Rank_17']
for col in int_columns:
    # Some ranks might be float in source, convert safely to int
    df_final[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_final[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

float_columns = [
    'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17', 'Economy_17', 'Family_17',
    'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]
for col in float_columns:
    df_final[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_final[col], errors='coerce')

# Save the final dataframe to CSV
df_final.to_csv(target_output_path, index=False)
